##  PAN / PAN Online
  * [हिंदी](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-tatkalpan.html#hindi)
[ What is the procedure for applying for PAN online? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-tatkalpan.html#english-01)
  * Click [here](https://onlineservices.proteantech.in/paam/endUserRegisterContact.html) to select the type of PAN application. * Fill the appropriate online form and select payment mode to complete the form submission. * On successful submission of online application and payment (for online mode of payment), an Acknowledgement receipt is generated. * Save and take a print out of the acknowledgement receipt. * Duly sign in the space provided, affix recent color photographs and submit the PAN application with supporting documents as under:   
1. Visit any of the [designated centre](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/List%20of%20centres%20for%20submission%20of%20online%20PAN%20documents.xls) and submit the said documents   
  
OR;   
  
2. Forward the said documents to   
  
**INCOME TAX PAN SERVICES UNIT**   
5th Floor, Mantri Sterling, Plot No. 341,   
Survey No. 997/8, Model Colony,   
Near Deep Bungalow Chowk,   
Pune - 411016   

  * The 15 digit acknowledgement no. appearing on the acknowledgement receipt can be used for tracking status of application. [ Who can apply for PAN? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-tatkalpan.html#english-collapseTwo)
All existing assessees or taxpayers or persons who are required to file a return of income, even on behalf of others, must have a PAN. Any person, who intends to enter into economic or financial transactions where quoting PAN is mandatory, must also have a PAN. [ Are there any additional charges for applying for PAN online? ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/faqs/pan/faq-pan-tatkalpan.html#english-collapseThree)
No. There are no **additional** charges for applying for PAN online. [ ऑनलाइन पैन आवेदन की प्रक्रिया क्या है?
